DC_BUFFER_NEW(3) Library Functions Manual DC_BUFFER_NEW(3)

NAME

dc_buffer_new — create an resizable binary buffer

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/buffer.h>

dc_buffer_t *
dc_buffer_new(size_t capacity);

DESCRIPTION

Create a resizable binary buffer of initial size capacity, which may be zero. The created buffer must be freed with dc_buffer_free(3).

RETURN VALUES

Returns a pointer to a dc_buffer_t or NULL on memory exhaustion.

SEE ALSO

dc_buffer_free(3)
